The Air Force Civilian Service (AFCS) is looking for a full-time IT Specialist (INFOSEC), GS-2210-14
located at the Information Technology & Security Division (SAS), Pentagon, Arlington, VA.

Special Salary Rate:
$143,000 – 163,000

Recruitment incentives may be available based on eligibility.

Depending on the type of position (competitive/excepted) you are selected for, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period OR 2-year trial period.

In this position, you will serve as the lead cybersecurity specialist and technical authority for the Secretary of the Air Force, Studies and Analysis, Operations Directorate, Information Technology & Security Division (SAF/SAS), with primary responsibility for securing and operating SCIF and Special Access Program (SAP) vault IT environments supporting cloud computing, high performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML), and advanced modeling and simulation capabilities critical to Air Force strategic decision-making.

Must be a U.S. Citizen
Must be able to obtain/maintain a Top Secret/SCI clearance

Kastle Systems
is the leader in managed security, with a track record of introducing innovative technologies to serve over 460M square feet of real estate globally. jobs.title: Security Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

About The Role

Security Operations Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day monitoring, analysis, and investigation of security threats across enterprise systems and networks. The role triages and responds to security alerts and incidents, working both independently and in collaboration with senior analysts on known or suspected threats.

The analyst supports incident response, threat intelligence, and forensic analysis activities in alignment with established security best practices and control frameworks. This includes identifying anomalies, escalating issues as appropriate, and contributing to the improvement of detection and response processes.

Security Operations Analysts may work shifts and participate in on-call rotations to support global operations and ensure continuous security monitoring coverage.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark:

Develop and deliver security reports and metrics to support operational awareness and leadership decision-making.
Identify and support mitigation of information security risks, including evaluating projects and initiatives for alignment with security requirements, policies, and standards.
Support internal and external audits by collecting and analyzing evidence, assessing control effectiveness, and ensuring adherence to established security frameworks and policies.
Track and manage remediation activities, including corrective action plans and audit findings, ensuring timely resolution of identified security issues.
Identify, investigate, and respond to security incidents, including analyzing root cause and impact to contain threats and reduce organizational risk.
Maintain and support security tools, controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure effective detection and response.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve threat-informed detections and automated response playbooks, including use case development, rule creation, tuning, validation, and optimization through incident feedback and testing.
Monitor systems and security telemetry for violations, vulnerabilities, and anomalous activity.
Analyze and apply threat intelligence to enhance detection, response, and situational awareness.
Identify and support onboarding and validation of security telemetry to ensure effective detection and visibility.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support incident response, remediation, and security improvements.
Assist in the evaluation and selection of security technologies and solutions to support detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed:

A degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field is desirable.
Industry-recognized certifications are a plus and may include: CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, Microsoft SC-200, GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), and relevant cloud or security vendor certifications (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, or cloud security platforms).
5-7 years of experience in security operations or related disciplines. with demonstrated expertise in security analysis and incident response.
Working knowledge of security controls including access control, authentication, encryption, system integrity, and logging as applied to security monitoring and detection.
Experience with security operations including monitoring, incident response, and incident management procedures, with the ability to investigate, escalate, and respond to security events.
Ability to develop, modify, and maintain threat detection rules within SIEM platforms, including tuning alerts and improving detection fidelity.
Understanding of security telemetry, including log collection and ingestion (e.g., syslog, Windows Event Forwarding, ELK), normalization, and data quality considerations to support effective detection and visibility.
Strong knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), identity systems (e.g., Active Directory), and network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS) as they relate to security monitoring and investigation.
Experience with endpoint, network, and host-based security tools including EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, vulnerability scanners, and host-based detection/prevention systems.
Ability to analyze and correlate data across multiple security and telemetry sources to identify patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and potential security threats.
Experience applying security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to map adversary behaviors and support detection and response development.
Experience with malware analysis, network forensics, and digital forensics concepts and tools; reverse engineering skills are a plus.
Ability to assess security threats and implement timely mitigations under pressure.
Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent to support automation, analysis, and response activities.
Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and non-technical teams.
Experience with security platforms and tools including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence tools (e.g., Google SecOps/Chronicle, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne Singularity, Tanium Threat Response, Recorded Future).
Experience with cloud security monitoring and native security services across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or OCI is a plus.
Familiarity with security-focused frameworks, methodologies, and best practices for detection, response, and vulnerability management is a plus.
Ability to analyze and apply threat intelligence to support detection, investigation, and response activities.
Experience developing or working with automated response workflows and playbooks (SOAR).
Advanced professional role requiring strong technical proficiency in security operations, detection, and incident response. Works independently with minimal supervision on complex investigations, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues, identify risks, and escalate appropriately.
Serves as a senior technical resource for the team, providing guidance, mentorship, and cross-training to junior analysts while promoting consistent standards for analysis, detection, and response. Contributes to the development and continuous improvement of detection logic, alert tuning, and response playbooks.
Effectively communicates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborates with peers on complex issues to enhance team capability. May assist in coordinating and tracking tasks for junior team members.

This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.

The Senior Enterprise Project Manager
owns the business casing, planning, delivery, adoption, and governance of strategic projects that sit at the intersection of technology and business. This role is the connective tissue between stakeholders who define the vision and the teams who build and deliver, responsible for end-to-end execution across technical and non-technical workstreams.

A defining characteristic of this role is the ability to bridge technology and business: translating complex data and systems initiatives into structured delivery plans with clear accountability, timelines, and outcomes.

Stakeholder liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact between project sponsors, business stakeholders, and delivery teams, balancing competing priorities with clarity and transparency.
Project Planning: Build and maintain detailed project plans, RAID logs, resource plans, and dependency maps; surface risks proactively before they become blockers.
Progress tracking and reporting: Monitor milestones and performance metrics; provide regular status updates to leadership, including executive-level reporting.
Resource management: Assess team capacity, allocate work according to skills and experience, and adjust as constraints shift throughout the project lifecycle.
Process optimization: Design and continuously refine project intake, planning, and execution processes to reduce backlog and improve delivery velocity across the organization.
Change management: Apply structured change management approaches to drive adoption of new systems, processes, and ways of working with business teams.
Task assignment: Assign individual workstream tasks to the right contributors based on expertise; reassess and realign as project conditions evolve.

Enterprise data concepts: master data management, data unification, data governance, Customer 360, CRM platforms

Experience with structured change management strategies, documentation, and knowledge sharing
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work experience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience reporting out to the C-suite
Exceptional multitasking, organizational, and planning skills
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building structure from scratch

Nice To Have Skills

Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification
Experience with data governance frameworks and cross-functional data stewardship
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or equivalent

We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay-for-performance rewards approach. jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. We're looking for a highly strategic Senior Principal Program Manager to join the GTM Excellence team within Reddit's GTM Strategy & Operations organization. In this heavily executive-facing role, you will operate as a Business Transformation Manager leading large-scale strategic initiatives—specifically owning end-to-end processes, transforming our methodologies, and evolving our systems, data, and products.

The ideal candidate brings immense executive presence, strong judgment, and a deep background in digital media forecasting to build the systems and processes that maximize customer-facing time and create a seamless experience for Reddit advertisers.

Location:
Hybrid. New York, NY; Chicago, IL; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA

Responsibilities:

Support core GTM leadership by managing Reddit's largest OPEX planning cycles, overseeing complex roadmaps, and ensuring decision-ready documents are prepared for monthly engagements with executive leadership, including the CRO and COO.
Own the end-to-end processes. Example: Manage and optimize stages across the buy cycle, including pipeline, forecasting methodologies, campaign planning, credit checks, credit limits, application, and invoicing.
Act as an extension of senior leadership. Engage heavily with the CRO, COO, and cross-functional senior leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Data Product to gather buy-in, pressure test ideas, and accelerate execution.
Break down ambiguous, high-impact opportunities into clear problem statements, develop hypotheses, drive analysis, and identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve how Reddit operates.
Own work from idea to execution, including rollout planning, stakeholder communication, training, and adoption. Navigate strong change management processes to ensure smooth transitions across a wide variety of sales spaces.
Evaluate how work gets done today, identify friction points and root causes, and design simpler, more standardized processes, policies, and ways of working that improve seller productivity and the advertiser experience.
Define success metrics, track results, gather feedback, and refine processes over time. Establish governance and guardrails where needed to drive consistency without adding unnecessary complexity.

8-12+ years of experience in strategic program management, business transformation, strategy & operations, or a related field.
Background in Digital Media companies (experience at a platform + agency is highly preferred).

Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and independently structure complex problems into clear recommendations and action plans.
Experience leading change management initiatives across cross-functional teams, from initial problem framing through implementation and adoption.
Ability to balance high-level strategic thinking with hands-on execution; this role requires an owner, not just a coordinator.

Startup experience in addition to larger tech/media platforms.
Strong foundational experience in basic strategy & operations or business operations.
Expertise in triaging complex issues, conducting root cause analysis, and utilizing competitive intelligence.
Familiarity with sales tools and technology that improve seller efficiency and productivity, including workflow automation and AI-enabled ways of working.
Deep Forecasting experience, including a proven track record of managing and transforming forecasting processes and the full RFP-to-invoice lifecycle.

About Us

DailyPay is the leader in On-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work.. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center.

The Role

DailyPay is seeking a forward-thinking, organized, results-driven Senior Implementation Manager to join our team. This individual will be a pivotal member of our implementation team, implementing new business and leading more complex integrations, as well as supporting re-implementations. The Senior Implementation Manager role will focus on our SMB & Enterprise business and will be responsible for managing the entire implementation from pre-sales support through post launch. Success in this role will rely on a combination of strong client and project management skills, technical proficiency, confidence, working with clients and C Suite stakeholders ,
and the ability to manage the details while seeing the bigger picture.We are looking for an out of the box thinker, who can execute a high volume of projects.

If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the qualifications.

How You Will Make An Impact

Lead new clients through our more complex implementations and support through a successful post launch handoff. This includes (but isn’t limited to): project and client management and leading the technical integration between DailyPay and 3rd party vendors
Manages technical and non technical stakeholders, as well as, ensure timely and accurate implementations holding both internal and external parties accountable
Perform comprehensive discovery and build robust documentation of the implementation requirements
Support re-implementations as required. This will include quality and on-time delivery, mitigating risk of operational loss, and reducing downtime
Serve as your clients internal advocate by effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams including Sales, Product, Client Success, and Implementation Controls
Work with product and other cross functional partners to support client projects as needed. This may include both proactively known requirements or uncovered requirements for new or improved functionality
Perform technical research to provide unique solutions for complex customer integrations
Flexible in an ever changing business environment with expanded volume and responsibility required at times to meet business needs
Provide technical mentorship, elevating team capabilities through knowledge sharing
Suggest new product features and functionality based on implementation experience and feedback from DailyPay customers

What You Bring To The Team

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
3-5+ years of experience in Implementation of SaaS solutions or technical Client Success Manager
Experience working with demanding, high-stakes accounts, managing operational and C-level stakeholders, and supporting day-to-day needs to manage these relationships
Detail-oriented with the ability to set priorities and be flexible in a changing environment
Excellent project and client management skills.
Excellent written communication and presentation skills
Experience leading data validation, unit testing, and UAT
Experience with sFTP automation and API builds (reviewing logs, troubleshooting, etc.)
Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite
A strong ability to drive solutions on unknown systems, processes and workflows
Experience in early stage products, markets, and companies preferred
Occasional need to work outside of normal business hours as required to support customers may be required

Nice To Haves

Experience with HCM, Payroll and Time Management Systems
Experience with Dell Boomi or similar products

What We Offer

Exceptional health, vision, and dental care
Opportunity for equity ownership
Life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability
Employee Assistance Program
Employee Resource Groups
Fun company outings and events
Unlimited PTO
401K with company match

to an inclusive, professional environment where multifaceted perspectives are our greatest competitive advantage. We recognize that our team members don’t live “single-issue lives,” and we lean into the wide-ranging backgrounds and life stages that sharpen our collective decision-making.

In our high-trust environment, we empower you to Challenge Norms
. We’ve created a space where it is safe to ask difficult questions, disrupt the status quo, and share bold perspectives without fear of professional fallout. We believe that by checking our own assumptions and staying curious about the experiences of others, we arrive at better, more innovative results.

We provide the space for you to do your best work through peer advocacy and transparent career development. If you are looking for a culture that values intellectual honesty, celebrates the unique lived experiences of its people, and thrives on collective success, you’ll find it here.

Hands-on operational experience with network management, tactical communication frameworks, and command and control interoperability tools, including MAVEN, NGC2, INB2, Terminus, and Tactical Assault Kit (TAK).

Proven track record authoring technical documentation, embedded system help, and configuration guides that enable novice operators to successfully install and maintain complex network software nodes.

Advanced AI and technical skills, including experience with agentic workflows, RAG, vector databases, and model orchestration in air-gapped environments.
Prior military service as a senior NCO, Warrant Officer, or Commissioned Officer (especially in a technical leadership position at a DIV/BCT or higher level).
Familiarity with tactical network planning tools, cryptographic key management (COMSEC), and constructing logical or geographic Network Common Operational Pictures (NetCOP)

Job Summary

Your Career

As the Principal for Competitive Intelligence within the Cortex Product Management organization, you are the strategic link between the competitive landscape and our product roadmap. You don't just report on the market; you influence what we build. By applying Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) to technical competitive data, you will provide the "Inconvenient Truths" that challenge our product assumptions. Ownership of DSPM + CIEM + ITDR portfolio, acting as the direct liaison and influencer to the Product Management organization. Go beyond CRM data to conduct structured analytic deep dives on significant losses, delivering actionable product feedback to Engineering and PM leadership to remove technical friction in the sales cycle.

Qualifications

Your Experience

8+ years in CI, Product Management, or Sales Engineering within the Cybersecurity space (DSPM, CIEM, DLP, IAM, PAM, & JIT).
Mastery of Structured Analytic Techniques. You must be able to move beyond "feature checklists" to produce high-nuance analysis that can withstand questioning from senior Product and Engineering leaders.
You can read a technical spec and understand the downstream implications for an enterprise security architect. You aren't just looking at the UI; you are looking at the architecture.
A core requirement for this team. You must be comfortable telling Product Leaders where their product is failing against the competition and backing it up with evidence.
Proven mastery in distilling high-density technical data and complex market signals into concise, high-impact "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) briefings. (You must demonstrate the ability to strip away technical noise to deliver clear, actionable recommendations that direct-influence Product and Executive decision-making.)
Experience facilitating "Red Hat" analytic sessions for product launches to identify how competitors will likely attack our new features.

Experience in Structured All-Source Analysis or other formal intelligence frameworks used to evaluate technical claims.
Deep familiarity with how security products are actually deployed and used in a 24/7 SOC enterprise environment.
CI Certification like CIP or similar.

jobs.description:
Description

Position at Resolver

The Business Intelligence Manager owns Resolver's internal business data: the data in Snowflake, the pipelines that feed it, and the reporting build on top. Much of the job is working out what's worth measuring. The manager helps work out definitions and sources with teams across Resolver, and finds the data that helps people decide quickly and well. On the infrastructure side, the work is building for scale and security while cutting the effort it takes to get from a question to an answer. Finding ways to put AI to work is part of the job. That starts with the team's own output and extends to spotting where it opens up work we couldn't take on before. The manager will take on a leadership role, including coaching direct reports and fostering a data-centric culture in the company at large.

About Resolver:

Resolver is a high-growth SaaS company whose intuitive, no-code platform fives our customers a clear picture of their risks so they can make quick and effective decisions. As a part of the Resolver team, your work will help transform risk management to risk intelligence so organizations can protect people and assets and deliver on their purpose.

We are ambitious in both our mission and our culture. As a business within Kroll, we offer an innovative, non-hierarchical work environment blended with the stability and financial security of an enterprise. Resolver has also been named one of Canada's Great Places to Work six years in a row.

What you'll be doing:

Strategy, Infrastructure & Planning (40%):

Measures of Success: High level of data and report accessibility with minimum time/effort to extract insights from data.

Project management: own the path from dashboard request to delivery, including intake, scoping, sequencing and follow-through.
Work with leaders across Resolver to understand department needs and what data best serves their goals.
Advise on best practices for designing and measuring key metrics, with a strong emphasis on what can delivery actionable insights.
Design, build and optimize all parts of the data warehouse infrastructure to support analysis of key data (requirements gathering, ETL, data modelling, metric design, etc.)
Detect data quality issues and their root causes proactively. Implement fixes and design data audits to capture the issues in the future.
Explore new data sources that can provide useful insights and inform company-wide strategy.
Evaluate new tools and processes that can advance our data capabilities while maintaining high level of security. Put AI to work where it actually changes what the team can take on.
Create and maintain documentation that is accurate, organized and understandable to the intended audience (bonus points if someone outside the data team can read it and actually learn something)

Dashboards & Data Analysis (40%):

Measures of Success: High level of stakeholder satisfaction.

With our team, develop, test and launch high quality dashboards to enable growth across Resolver.
Administer Tableau Cloud, maintain existing dashboards to ensure a high standard.
Develop and maintain AI-powered reporting solutions (Snowflake Cortex Analyst)
Serve as reporting resource for all Resolver divisions, including deep-dive analyses that require wrangling complex data and problems.
Proactively identify trends and business insights that improve results against core corporate KPIs: APR, win-rate, back-to-back revenue.
Generate hypotheses on cross-functional data and run experiments to test efficacy.

Leadership & Team Building (20%):

Measures of Success: Best in class team engagement scores. Clear development of career plans for team members. Both senior and junior stakeholders show sophisticated understanding of data.

Maximize team's impact by providing oversight, support and guidance.
Coordinate use of resources, resolve bottlenecks, review of projects and potential risks.
Mentor and coach the team to achieve OKRs and personal performance objectives. Work closely with team members to create personalized development plans that allow for in-role growth and long-term opportunities.
Beyond the direct business intelligence team, serve as an ambassador for the department.
Regularly report to the executive team on the business impact of the BI infrastructure and BI-related project.
Educate departments on new data technology and methods. Create the building blocks for a data-centric cutlure.
Act as a senior member of the marketing team to define and build team culture and contribute to discussions on improving team engagement and growth.

What you will bring:

5+ years work experience in business intelligence and data analysis
Strong knowledge of BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo)
Expert in SQL
Experience with Snowflake or a similar data platform. (Bonus points if you have hands-on experience with the platforms' AI capabilities
Experience in data modelling, designing ETL processes
Background in analytics, mathematics or another quantitative field would be amazing
Experience with Python or R is a plus
Post secondary degree is required
Ability to leverage research and industry best practices to design repeatable, scalable business processes
High level of organization with ability to manage business processes with a keen eye for detail
Strong alignment to deadlines and the ability to prioritize competing priorities
Ability to leverage an analytical mindset to improve process
Ability to translate business process design into system design
Ability to understand data to provide insights that will improve performance of both individuals and the team

What we'll give you in return:

Health and Wellness benefits: 100% paid for by us for health and dental from day one. And our vision care is every 12 months! We also offer a wellness/fitness reimbursement, that can go towards thing like gym memberships, yoga classes, soccer membership fees or a bike.
Professional development: we have an external learning budget to help you grow and develop. We host a learning workshop about every 6 weeks on topics like Time Management, Self-Awareness and Giving Feedback, we also have e-learning to meet the needs of our remote team. We offer a Career Development Program to help you identify and build your skillsets for internal growth opportunities and beyond. We also have a Coaching Program for all our managers. We know how important it is to have a good boss, so we invest in their development.
Vacation: it's open, which means we don't have to worry about an accrual clock. On average, we see most folks enjoying between 3-4 weeks off a year.
Parental leave: best-in-class top-up for new parents -- 100% for 15 weeks for new parents and 5 additional weeks of pregnancy leave for birth mothers.
Flexibility & trust: We hire adults and we trust you to manage your outcomes. Day-to-day, everyone is given the option to decide whether they want to work remote or in-office depending on the needs of their role and in ways that best promote collaboration with your team.
Back in the Office: You will have access to snacks and beverages and in-office fun like ping pong, group lunches, karaoke & games. We provide lots of opportunity for team socials too, including the folks who are remote!
The salary range for this role is $100,000 to $115,000

Interested?

With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

About The Role

Security Operations Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day monitoring, analysis, and investigation of security threats across enterprise systems and networks. The role triages and responds to security alerts and incidents, working both independently and in collaboration with senior analysts on known or suspected threats.

The analyst supports incident response, threat intelligence, and forensic analysis activities in alignment with established security best practices and control frameworks. This includes identifying anomalies, escalating issues as appropriate, and contributing to the improvement of detection and response processes.

Security Operations Analysts may work shifts and participate in on-call rotations to support global operations and ensure continuous security monitoring coverage.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark:

Develop and deliver security reports and metrics to support operational awareness and leadership decision-making.
Identify and support mitigation of information security risks, including evaluating projects and initiatives for alignment with security requirements, policies, and standards.
Support internal and external audits by collecting and analyzing evidence, assessing control effectiveness, and ensuring adherence to established security frameworks and policies.
Track and manage remediation activities, including corrective action plans and audit findings, ensuring timely resolution of identified security issues.
Identify, investigate, and respond to security incidents, including analyzing root cause and impact to contain threats and reduce organizational risk.
Maintain and support security tools, controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure effective detection and response.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve threat-informed detections and automated response playbooks, including use case development, rule creation, tuning, validation, and optimization through incident feedback and testing.
Monitor systems and security telemetry for violations, vulnerabilities, and anomalous activity.
Analyze and apply threat intelligence to enhance detection, response, and situational awareness.
Identify and support onboarding and validation of security telemetry to ensure effective detection and visibility.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support incident response, remediation, and security improvements.
Assist in the evaluation and selection of security technologies and solutions to support detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed:

A degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field is desirable.
Industry-recognized certifications are a plus and may include: CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, Microsoft SC-200, GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), and relevant cloud or security vendor certifications (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, or cloud security platforms).
5-7 years of experience in security operations or related disciplines. with demonstrated expertise in security analysis and incident response.
Working knowledge of security controls including access control, authentication, encryption, system integrity, and logging as applied to security monitoring and detection.
Experience with security operations including monitoring, incident response, and incident management procedures, with the ability to investigate, escalate, and respond to security events.
Ability to develop, modify, and maintain threat detection rules within SIEM platforms, including tuning alerts and improving detection fidelity.
Understanding of security telemetry, including log collection and ingestion (e.g., syslog, Windows Event Forwarding, ELK), normalization, and data quality considerations to support effective detection and visibility.
Strong knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), identity systems (e.g., Active Directory), and network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS) as they relate to security monitoring and investigation.
Experience with endpoint, network, and host-based security tools including EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, vulnerability scanners, and host-based detection/prevention systems.
Ability to analyze and correlate data across multiple security and telemetry sources to identify patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and potential security threats.
Experience applying security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to map adversary behaviors and support detection and response development.
Experience with malware analysis, network forensics, and digital forensics concepts and tools; reverse engineering skills are a plus.
Ability to assess security threats and implement timely mitigations under pressure.
Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent to support automation, analysis, and response activities.
Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and non-technical teams.
Experience with security platforms and tools including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence tools (e.g., Google SecOps/Chronicle, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne Singularity, Tanium Threat Response, Recorded Future).
Experience with cloud security monitoring and native security services across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or OCI is a plus.
Familiarity with security-focused frameworks, methodologies, and best practices for detection, response, and vulnerability management is a plus.
Ability to analyze and apply threat intelligence to support detection, investigation, and response activities.
Experience developing or working with automated response workflows and playbooks (SOAR).
Advanced professional role requiring strong technical proficiency in security operations, detection, and incident response. Works independently with minimal supervision on complex investigations, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues, identify risks, and escalate appropriately.
Serves as a senior technical resource for the team, providing guidance, mentorship, and cross-training to junior analysts while promoting consistent standards for analysis, detection, and response. Contributes to the development and continuous improvement of detection logic, alert tuning, and response playbooks.
Effectively communicates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborates with peers on complex issues to enhance team capability. May assist in coordinating and tracking tasks for junior team members.

Concur services adapt to individual employee preferences and scale to meet the needs of companies from small to large, so they can focus on what matters most. The Program Manager for Change Management is a high-impact, cross-functional role embedded within our Engineering Operations organization. You will partner directly with product and engineering leaders to define, govern, and continuously improve software change management policy — helping Concur maintain compliance, reduce risk, and accelerate safe delivery at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who leads through influence, thrives in ambiguity, and brings both technical fluency and operational rigor to the table.

What You'll Do

Be part of team that is responsible for:

Defining Change Management policy and governance for Concur’s product and engineering teams
Change management audit controls and corresponding test strategy, plan and and evidence collection in support of PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and related compliance programs
Communicating change management policy to our product and engineering teams on a regular basis to ensure understanding and adoption
Facilitating key change advisory boards (CABs) in collaboration with product and engineering leadership
Overseeing planned change activities in alignment with release cadences and business operating rhythms

What You Will Bring

Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent education
Many years of software product, project or program management experience
Experience with security frameworks including PCI DSS, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, 22301
Critical thinking & structured problem-solving skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills including the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Experience with basic scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell), SQL queries, Jira, Github are highly desired
Experience with SaaS architecture and cloud platforms; AWS experience a plus

We highly value

Leadership through innovation
Driving outcomes through influence, not just authority
Growth mindset - you reflect, learn from failure, and continuously improve
Passion and curiosity for your work
Ownership mentality: You follow through, do what you say and say what you do
Transparency and inclusivity in how you communicate and collaborate
Personal and corporate integrity

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Cardinal Health Canada, with over 1,300 employees nationwide, is an essential link in the Canadian healthcare supply chain, providing over 70,000 products to healthcare facilities and medical professionals across the country.

Cardinal Health Canada is seeking a Contracts & Sales Operations Analyst
to join the Contract Management team. Reporting to the Manager, Contract Management, the Analyst supports the administration and ongoing management of customer agreements across the Canadian business portfolio. The position helps ensure that agreements, pricing contracts, rebates, customer memberships, and related commercial activities are administered accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with service, compliance, and revenue-protection requirements. This role requires on-site presence at the Tesma (Vaughan) head office every Tuesday and Wednesday.

The Analyst independently manages post-award contract lifecycle activities, serves as a key liaison between customers and internal stakeholders, and coordinates requests and contractual requirements within established service levels. Success in the role requires accurate and timely administration, consistently high data and reporting quality, effective management of assigned work with minimal supervision, and providing a positive customer experience. The position also supports pricing validation, contract compliance, reporting, audits and operational data management. In addition, the analyst identifies discrepancies, facilitates issue resolution and contributes to process improvement, automation and revenue protection.

Your Contribution to the Organization

Administer post-award customer agreements, including customer and product additions, pricing updates, amendments, and other contract maintenance activities.
Maintain accurate customer, contract, membership, pricing, rebate, and account information across our Sales management system (Salesforce), contract repositories, and other business systems.
Ensure all new customer accounts are set-up accurately within the appropriate memberships, channels, and customer master data.
Manage inbound customer requests and serve as a primary contact for inquiries related to contract administration, pricing, account maintenance, validation, and agreement support.
Support pricing administration, including approved updates, contract escalators, pricing validation, discrepancy resolution, and revenue-protection activities.
Administer rebate programs through validation, system execution, monitoring, reconciliation support, and reporting.
Produce accurate, high-quality recurring and ad hoc reports and analyze contract and operational data to identify trends, discrepancies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
Support contract compliance, documentation, audits, record retention, data-quality monitoring, and adherence to governance requirements.
Collaborate with Sales, Pricing, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Customer Care, and Contracts teams to coordinate customer and business requirements.
Maintain standard operating procedures, workflows, and business records, and participate in process improvement, automation, and system-enhancement, and operational-efficiency initiatives.

This Job Might Be For You If

2 years of experience in contract administration, sales or commercial operations, pricing administration, customer support, business operations, account management or a related analytical role.
Bachelors degree in business administration or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of post-secondary education and experience.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, competing deadlines, and assigned post-award activities independently and with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong customer-service orientation and the ability to build effective relationships with customers, stakeholders, and business partners.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, PivotTables, lookups, and data-validation techniques.
Comfortable navigating and reporting from various systems (Conga or other contract-lifecycle management systems, Salesforce, SAP, Tableau, Power BI, SharePoint, Adobe Acrobat Sign – or any similar tools or systems).
Ability to identify and appropriately escalate operational, compliance, pricing, and data-integrity issues.
Solution-oriented, customer-focused approach and commitment to continuous improvement.
Experience in healthcare, medical devices, healthcare distribution, or another regulated industry is an asset.

Job Summary

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking experienced candidates for a Data Analyst IV - Advanced Analytics & Reporting position within Access & Eligibility Services (AES), Data Management & Reporting team. The position supports HHSC’s mission to connect Texans to essential services by delivering advanced analytics, ensuring data quality, and providing operational decision support to internal teams.

Data Analyst IV functions as a senior individual contributor and hybrid analyst/mentor. The role performs complex analytical work under minimal supervision, applies independent judgment, mentors and reviews the work of other analysts, and delivers clear, actionable insights to non‑technical stakeholders. These positions do not have formal supervisory authority.

Operational Decision Support & Reporting (20%)

Data Pipelines & Performance (15%)

Contributes to future‑state analytics solutions, including readiness for Databricks adoption.

Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and documentation practices.
Ability to perform predictive and trend analysis aligned with business needs.

Demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, data integrity, curiosity, and problem‑solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with business analysts, developers, and program staff.

jobs.description:
Staff Data Analyst · Lead Data Analyst · Principal Data Analyst · Staff Analytics Engineer · Lead Analytics Engineer · Principal Analytics Engineer · Staff BI Engineer ·

1. About the Role

We are hiring a Staff / Lead-level Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer
to embed with the Monetization Data Science & Analytics team as a senior individual contributor and technical leader
. This person will be the go-to analytics expert for advertiser revenue, monetization performance, and growth metrics — trusted by Data Scientists, Analysts, PMs, and Engineering leaders to drive high-impact work end-to-end.

This is a staff-level Individual Contributor role
, not a mid-level execution seat. The successful candidate operates as:

A trusted thought partner
to Data Scientists and Product leaders — someone who improves the quality of the question before answering it.
A technical leader
who sets standards for data models, pipelines, and dashboards that others follow.
A force multiplier
who unblocks the team by identifying and fixing root causes across the data stack, not just building what's asked.

The ideal candidate has grown up on the analytics side
of the house (Business Analyst, Product Analyst, BI Analyst) and, over 9+ years, developed deep data engineering, modeling, and visualization expertise. They have led complex, cross-functional analytics initiatives and have a track record of raising the bar wherever they've worked.

Who this role is NOT for:
anyone who executes tickets, waits for direction, escalates data mismatches without triage, or cannot articulate the business rationale behind their work. We're paying for judgment, ownership, and craft — not hours.

2. Work Mix

50% — Analytics, Business Insights & Technical Leadership
Partnering with Data Scientists and Product on the hardest analytics problems; driving metric definitions; reviewing others' analyses; setting standards for the team's analytics work.

30% — Data Engineering & Pipeline Ownership
Architecting and owning production SQL pipelines, data models, and data cubes; designing and operating Airflow DAGs; setting the bar for data quality, reliability, and reconciliation across the domain.

20% — Data Visualization, Metric Governance & Enablement
Owning executive-visibility dashboards in Tableau / Superset; defining and governing metrics; enabling self-serve analytics for the broader Monetization org.

3. Key Responsibilities

Analytics Leadership & Business Partnership

Serve as the senior analytics IC
for the Monetization Analytics pod — the person Data Scientists and PMs come to with the hardest, most ambiguous data problems.
Improve the quality of the question before answering — reframe vague asks into sharper, more valuable analytical approaches.
Lead end-to-end analytics initiatives
that span data modeling, pipeline work, and dashboard delivery — with minimal supervision and clear stakeholder communication throughout.
Set metric definitions and standards
for advertiser revenue, monetization performance, funnel/cohort metrics, and experiment readouts — and drive consistency across dashboards.
Independently drive root-cause analysis
on data discrepancies across dashboards, warehouses, or pipelines — including cross-team debugging when needed.
Review, coach, and raise the bar on the work of other analysts and analytics engineers on the team.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture

Architect and own
production-grade SQL data pipelines (Presto / Trino / Hive / Spark SQL) — including making the right tradeoffs on incremental vs. full refresh, pre-aggregation, and cost/performance.
Design and own data cubes, aggregate tables, and semantic layers
used by the whole Monetization Analytics function.
Author, own, and operate Airflow DAGs
for critical revenue and monetization pipelines — including SLAs, on-call posture, backfills, and incident response.
Set and enforce standards for data quality, reconciliation, and observability
— row counts, revenue tie-outs, distribution checks, anomaly alerting — across the domain.
Optimize existing pipelines aggressively for cost and latency (partitioning, incremental refresh, query tuning on billion+ row tables) — and quantify the wins.
Contribute to cross-team technical decisions
— table designs, upstream schema changes, migration plans (e.g., Hive → Trino) — via design docs and reviews.

Data Visualization, Metric Governance & Enablement

Own the design and quality of executive and cross-functional dashboards
in Tableau and/or Superset.
Drive metric governance
— clear definitions, owners, source-of-truth queries, validation, deprecation.
Enable self-serve analytics
for Data Scientists, Analysts, and PMs — clear naming, documentation, certified metrics, sensible defaults, and coaching.

4. Required Qualification

Experience

9+ years of combined experience
in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering roles.
At least 3+ years at Senior level or above
in an analytics-adjacent role at a high-scale tech, ads-tech, marketplace, or fintech company.
Prior experience as the most senior analytics IC
on an embedded team — or a strong case for why they're ready to step into that role now.
Track record of leading end-to-end analytics initiatives
— from ambiguous business question through data model, pipeline, dashboard, and rollout.
Prior experience partnering directly with US-based Data Science, Product, and Engineering leaders
as a full contributor.

Technical Skills — SQL & Data Engineering (Advanced)

Expert-level SQL
— deep proficiency with window functions, CTEs, complex joins, query optimization, incremental patterns, skew mitigation, and cost tuning on billion+ row tables.
Deep hands-on
with at least two of: Presto, Trino, Hive, Spark SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift
. Can reason about query plans and physical layout, not just syntax.
Advanced Airflow
— has architected and operated large DAG ecosystems (50+ production DAGs), including cross-DAG dependencies, backfills at scale, and SLA management. Equivalent orchestrators (Dagster, Prefect) also acceptable if depth is comparable.
Data architecture & modeling depth
— Kimball, star schema, dimensional modeling, OLAP cubes, wide fact tables, slowly-changing dimensions, semantic layer design. Can defend design tradeoffs in a design review.
ETL / ELT architecture
— incremental loads, backfills, idempotency, data quality frameworks, lineage.
Python
for data work — pandas, PySpark, scripting, and light tooling development.
dbt
or equivalent transformation framework experience strongly preferred.
Experience contributing to or reviewing design docs and RFCs
for data platforms and pipelines.

Technical Skills — Visualization

Deep, hands-on production experience building executive-grade dashboards
in Tableau and/or
Apache Superset (Looker, Power BI, Mode also acceptable).
Strong opinions on dashboard design — headline vs. drilldown metrics, layout, filters, performance, self-serve UX.
Experience driving metric governance
and self-serve BI at an org level.

Analytics & Business Skills

Strong grasp of KPI definition, metric design, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B testing methodology
.
Deep exposure to digital advertising / monetization metrics
— impressions, clicks, CTR, CPM, CPC, CVR, ROAS, revenue attribution, incrementality — is strongly preferred.
Prior experience at ads-tech, digital media, or major consumer/marketplace tech companies (Meta, Google, Amazon, Uber, DoorDash, Snap, TikTok, LinkedIn, Airbnb, Instacart, Pinterest peers, etc.) is a strong plus.
Comfort reading experiment results and challenging methodology when needed.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

Native or near-native English
(spoken and written) — this is a hard requirement.
Track record of leading initiatives
end-to-end with minimal direction — scoping, aligning stakeholders, executing, and communicating results.
Comfortable pushing back on unclear or misdirected requirements
and proposing better approaches.
Prolific writer of design docs, RFCs, requirement docs, and postmortems
.
Experience mentoring or coaching
less-senior analysts and analytics engineers — even if not a formal manager.
Executive presence — can present analytics work to Director/VP-level stakeholders and defend recommendations.
Operates with the ownership mindset of a permanent employee
, even in a contract role.

5. Nice-to-Have

Prior experience as a Staff / Principal Analytics Engineer
, Staff Data Analyst
, or Analytics Tech Lead
at a top-tier tech company.
Experience with A/B testing platforms
and complex experimentation analysis (variance reduction, quasi-experiments, incrementality).
Solid statistics
foundation (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, regression basics) — enough to challenge a Data Scientist's methodology.
Experience with data catalogs, lineage tools, or metric layer platforms
(Amundsen, DataHub, Atlan, Cube, Transform, etc.).
Experience contributing to internal analytics platform / tooling improvements.
Tableau certification (Certified Associate or Professional) or equivalent.
Prior contract or fractional-lead experience with US-based tech companies.

8. Screen-Out Signals (Please Filter These Out)

Candidates who match on tools but show these behaviors are not
a fit for a Staff-level role:

Resume claims "senior" but the bullets read as execution ("built pipeline X, wrote SQL Y, delivered table Z") with no scope, impact, or business context.
Cannot describe an initiative they led end-to-end that spanned analytics + data engineering + visualization.
Escalates data mismatches immediately without first-pass debugging.
No evidence of mentoring or raising the bar for others.
Only executes exactly what's written in the ticket; no interpretation or judgment.
No prior experience partnering directly with US-based Data Science / Analytics / Product leaders.

Job Description

Job Description

Strategy & Analytics plays a critical role for the Global Solutions Center of Excellence (CoE) to help evolve the Solutions Organization into the next generation of talent, drive alignment between Product and Sales, and accelerate Salesforce's path to $60B.

As we invest in a data-driven approach to Solution Engineering, measuring and communicating impact is critical. The Analyst, Solution Engineering CoE will serve as a key analytical contributor supporting the broader Solutions Engineering organization — providing reporting, insights, and operational support that enable our teams to perform at their best.

This individual will be responsible for building and maintaining reporting frameworks, KPI dashboards, and data infrastructure that help leadership understand the health and effectiveness of the Solutions Engineering organization. You will work across a range of topics — from team performance and pipeline analytics to AI tooling adoption and SE productivity — providing the insights that drive strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Framework & Infrastructure: Partner with the Global Analytics team to create a "single source of truth" for Solution Engineering data. Design and maintain the datasets, views, and data pipelines required to track SE program performance.
Reporting & Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain scalable dashboards (Tableau, CRM Analytics) that provide real-time visibility into program health for stakeholders ranging from operational leads to executive leadership.
SE Performance Insights: Analyze Solutions Engineering activity and outcomes to surface trends in productivity, pipeline influence, and engagement. Correlate SE activity with deal outcomes (conversion rates, cycle time, ACV) to validate organizational impact.
Tools & AI Enablement Analytics: Support the Solutions Tools Program by analyzing adoption rates and usage patterns across SE tooling and AI-assisted workflows. Provide data-driven recommendations to support investment and enablement decisions.
Strategic Recommendations: Translate complex data into actionable insights. Regularly prepare analysis and recommendations for Solutions CoE & Solutions leadership to support investment planning and resource optimization.
Business Reviews: Assist in developing data narratives and presentations for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive updates, ensuring data accuracy and compelling storytelling.
Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in data collection processes and propose operational changes to improve data quality and reliability.

Skills/Expertise Required

Data Visualization & Storytelling: Strong proficiency in building dashboards in Tableau and CRM Analytics/Einstein Analytics. Ability to convey data narratives clearly via slide presentations (Google Slides/PowerPoint).

Technical Proficiency: Experience aggregating and manipulating datasets using SQL, SOQL, or similar tools. Proficiency in Snowflake for data querying and exploration is required. Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets is required.
Operational Business Acumen: Ability to connect data to business outcomes. Exposure to Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, or a Solutions Engineering environment is a plus.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with both technical teams (IT, Data Science) and non-technical stakeholders (Sales/Solutions Leadership) to move analytics projects forward.
Self-Starter: High degree of motivation and intellectual curiosity. Comfortable working with ambiguity and driving projects from idea to execution with moderate supervision.

Desired Experience

Hands-on experience with Tableau for dashboard development and data storytelling is highly preferred.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake for data querying and pipeline support is highly preferred.
Experience with Salesforce object architecture and reporting is a strong plus.
Background in management consulting, finance, sales strategy, or solutions engineering is preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Print)
jobs.description:
The Program Manager is responsible for providing the end-to-end customer experience for a major account customer, serving as the single point of accountability across installation, training, ongoing service, and contractual performance. This role acts as the executive-level program owner — orchestrating Marco's Project Management, Service, Sales, Account Management, and Billing teams to deliver on every commitment made to the client, with particular emphasis on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for installation, delivery, training, walk-throughs, and ongoing service.

Operating at the intersection of the customer and Marco's internal operations, the Program Manager governs a structured cadence of program reviews, escalation management, and continuous improvement activities. This position requires strong business and industry awareness, fluency in managed services and SLA-driven delivery models, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to maintain consistent, high-quality client experience across a complex, multi-site major account environment.

Essential Functions

Customer Program Ownership & SLA Governance
Serve as the executive-level program owner and single point of accountability for the assigned major account customer.
Govern all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across installation, delivery, training, walk-throughs, response time, uptime, and ongoing service — actively monitoring, reporting on, and intervening before commitments are at risk.
Lead a recurring customer governance cadence including weekly operational stand-ups, monthly service reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with client leadership.
Produce executive-ready program reporting: SLA scorecards, fleet performance, ticket trends, project status, financial summary, and strategic roadmap.
Serve as the single escalation point for the customer — triage issues, mobilize the appropriate Marco team, drive resolution, and close the loop with documented root cause and corrective action.
Identify continuous improvement and account growth opportunities; partner with Sales and Account Management to expand Marco's footprint where it serves the client.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure all installations and deployments are on-time, on-budget, and aligned with client expectations and business workflow.
Coordinate with Service Operations to align SLA performance, dispatch priority, on-site response, and field technician scheduling for the account.
Collaborate with Sales and Account Management on contract renewals, expansion opportunities, pricing conversations, and commercial strategy within the account.
Work directly with the Billing and Finance teams to validate invoice accuracy, expedite dispute resolution, and protect the customer experience around billing and contracts.
Engage Solution Engineering, OEM partners, and vendors to coordinate technical design changes and external escalations as required.
Maintain a documented stakeholder map, escalation matrix, and RACI for the account so that the program is never a single-person dependency.

Major Account Customer Delivery

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation
jobs.description:
Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:
06/10/2026

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

As a Senior Project Manager
, you will lead multiple enterprise projects interacting with cross-functional teams comprised of internal & external technical contributors, IT managers and various other stakeholders. You will serve as the liaison with project sponsors and vendors and will facilitate continuous communication and manage expectations. You will be expected to coordinate the resolution of complex issues and challenging situations. This is a subset of the overall responsibilities which will include multiple initiatives as assigned by IT leadership.

This role is hybrid (Mon through Thu on-site / Fri remote) at the UMB Technology & Operations Center located in downtown Kansas City, MO.

Managing multiple projects across data analytics and/or digital banking programs.
Developing business case for executive review and approval of new projects.
Working with project team and stakeholders to establish consensus on project scope, deliverables, and outcomes.
Planning, monitoring, adjusting, and communicating the project’s schedule.
Identifying constraints, risks and coordinating problem resolution of complex issues.
Tracking, measuring, and reporting on project status and progress.
Coordinating with IT resource managers and implementation partners to ensure the project has proper staffing during each phase/sprint of the SDLC.
Ensuring project methodology, standards, processes, and procedures are followed throughout the life of the project.

We are excited to talk if you have

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration or related discipline AND at least 8 years of IT project management experience.
Experience with Agile/Scrum and Waterfall project methodologies.
Proficiency utilizing a Project Portfolio Management (PPM) tool (i.e. Sciforma, MS Project, etc.).
Knowledge and experience in financial services process/workflow including data management, card transactions, core banking deposits and customer processing, loan processing, payments, and fraud management.

Bonus Points if you have

At least 1 year of management experience.
PMP certification.
Knowledge of various systems/applications (i.e TA System, SharePoint).

Applicants must have legal authority to work in the United States. Work Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

This position was posted on 08/10/2026. The application deadline for this position is 45 days from the posting date unless filled earlier.

$117,900 - $173,393
